plan.cache: Input hash verification and discarded warmup pair warm filesystem cache. No cache eviction; results are repeated warm-cache load cost, not cold disk performance.

plan.contamination: Ordinary PCactivity allowed and recorded. No competing developer builds/tests/downloads/modeljobs during reservedrun. No quietgate, isolated sample deletion or replacement. Any protocoldeviation retained and disclosed.
plan.statistics: All5paired changes main_ms/candidate_ms-1, plus absolute means/medians/min/max and pairedwins; descriptive95percent tinterval df4 t2.7764451051977987. No automatic singlecase cutoff and no inference/mxparity claim.
plan.failures: Stop on load error, missing/malformed report, fingerprint mismatch or timeout; preserve every partial sample and raw log. No restarts. Kill/wait only owned child if timeout; monitor stopped and reaped.
